input.input: City of Boston apply for business certificate

tool_calls.output:
Here’s how to apply for a City of Boston business certificate (DBA/new filing) and where to get the form.

Quick steps
- Get the application form (printable PDF). Check the box for “New filing,” complete the form, and have the owner’s signature notarized (the City Clerk can notarize if you bring valid photo ID). ([boston.gov](https://www.boston.gov/sites/default/files/file/2025/03/2025-New-Business-Certificate-Form_0.pdf?utm_source=openai))  
- Gather required documents: business name & address, names/addresses of owners/people with an interest in the business, and proof of occupancy (signed lease or a notarized landlord letter). You cannot use a virtual address or PO Box for the business location. ([boston.gov](https://www.boston.gov/departments/city-clerk/how-apply-business-certificate?utm_source=openai))  
- Submit in person or by mail:
  - In person: City Clerk’s Office, Room 601, 1 City Hall Square, Boston (hours Mon–Fri 9:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m.). ([boston.gov](https://www.boston.gov/departments/city-clerk/how-apply-business-certificate?utm_source=openai))  
  - By mail: include the completed form, payment, and a self-addressed stamped envelope to Office of the City Clerk, 1 City Hall Square, Room 601, Boston, MA 02201. ([boston.gov](https://www.boston.gov/departments/city-clerk/how-apply-business-certificate?utm_source=openai))  
- Renewals and fees: certificates must be renewed every four years. A late fee penalty is applied for failures to renew as required by state law. Non‑Massachusetts residents may owe an additional fee (see the form/page). ([boston.gov](https://www.boston.gov/departments/city-clerk/how-apply-business-certificate?utm_source=openai))

Where to get the official info and form
- How to Apply for a Business Certificate (City Clerk page) — main instructions and contact info. ([boston.gov](https://www.boston.gov/departments/city-clerk/how-apply-business-certificate?utm_source=openai))  
- Official downloadable business certificate form (PDF). ([boston.gov](https://www.boston.gov/sites/default/files/file/2025/03/2025-New-Business-Certificate-Form_0.pdf?utm_source=openai))  
- City services landing page (links to Apply for a Business Certificate). ([boston.gov](https://www.boston.gov/city-boston-services-applications-and-permits?utm_source=openai))

Need anything else?
- I can open the PDF form and walk you through the fields, check required attachments for your business type, or help draft the landlord letter. Which would you like?

answer:
To apply for a business certificate (DBA) in Boston, start by downloading the [business certificate application form (PDF)](https://www.boston.gov/sites/default/files/file/2025/03/2025-New-Business-Certificate-Form_0.pdf?utm_source=openai) and ensuring you check the box for "New filing."
